_comment: Model family profiles. Read at startup by ggufloader/core/llm/model_profiles.py. This build ships ONE family (gemma4); any other GGUF falls through to the conservative GENERIC_PROFILE in model_profiles.py.

families.name: Google Gemma 4 12B Instruct
families.notes: Official Gemma 4 sampling guidance (temp 1.0, no repeat penalty). The agent path caps temperature/top_k per purpose and applies REPEAT_PENALTY_FLOOR (see core/defaults.py) because the Q4_K_M quant degenerates into repetition loops at the family default.
